---
title: "Stage 2 — Persistence simulation"
output: html_document
params:
  config_file: "config/madagascar.yml"
  mode: "inspect"
  verbose: false
  threads: null
---

```{r run, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
source(file.path("R", "stage2_workflow.R"))
rmd_options <- project_rmd_params("2_persistence_simulation.Rmd")
configured <- rmd_project_config(rmd_options, "stage2")
rmd_params <- configured$params
model_paths <- persistence_model_paths(
  quasi_extinction_abundance = rmd_params$quasi_extinction_abundance,
  persistence_horizon_years = rmd_params$persistence_horizon_years
)
config <- stage2_config(
  c(rmd_params, list(taxa = "both")), # reusable models contain both branches
  model_paths$project, model_paths$source_project
)
cat(describe_stage2_config(config), "\n")
stage2_result <- run_stage2_model(config, model_paths)
```

## Trait branches

```{r branches, echo=FALSE}
print(knitr::kable(stage2_result$branch_summary, row.names = FALSE))
```

## Artifact status

```{r artifacts, echo=FALSE}
print(knitr::kable(stage2_result$artifact_status, row.names = FALSE))
cat("Grid signature:", stage2_result$grid_signature, "\n")
cat("Elapsed seconds:", sprintf("%.1f", stage2_result$elapsed_seconds), "\n")
if (!is.null(stage2_result$runtime_log_path)) {
  cat("Runtime log:", stage2_result$runtime_log_path, "\n")
}
```
